target.title: fix(oauth): pass workspace context to resolveProviderIdForAuth on refresh failure
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

When an OAuth token refresh fails with a reused refresh token error, the cleanup block clears the cached profile snapshot entry. During this, it calls `resolveProviderIdForAuth(cred.provider)`.

However, the call was missing the optional `params` context (`config` and `workspaceDir`). Because of this, workspace-scoped provider aliases (which are configured via plugins or workspace-specific manifests) could not be resolved correctly on refresh failure cleanup, leaving stale/broken cache snapshots.

## Fix

Pass the `config` and `workspaceDir` parameters through to `resolveProviderIdForAuth` in the refresh failure handler, and propagate `workspaceDir` from the entry points.

## Test plan

Ran `src/agents/auth-profiles/oauth.test.ts` unit tests, all 17 tests passed successfully.


## Evidence
